data.gender_notes: Joriel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Joriel is derived from the name 'Joram', meaning 'descendent of Yahweh', or 'God is my light'. The name Joriel has biblical roots, being mentioned in the Old Testament as the name of a king and a prophet. Joriel symbolizes light, hope, and divine guidance in times of darkness. The name Joriel carries the meaning “God is my light” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Joriel usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's light and guidance in one's life.
data.etymology: Joriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God is my light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joriel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: יוֹרִיאֵל
in_hebrew.meaning: אל שופט ומנהיג, האור של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: יוֹרִיאֵל הוא שם עברי שמורכב מיוֹרי, שפירושו אל שופט ומנהיג, ומאֵל, שפירושו אלוהים. הוא נחשב לשם שמלמד על האור וההדרכה של אלוהים, ועל השופט והמנהיג שמונו על ידי אלוהים. השם יוֹרִיאֵל משמש לעתים קרובות בהקשר של שמות מלאכים וישויות רוחניות אחרות.

in_greek.name: Ιωριήλ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι φως και καθοδήγηση
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ιωριήλ είναι εβραϊκής προέλευσης και σημαίνει Ο Θεός είναι φως και καθοδήγηση. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα αυτό δεν αναφέρεται συγκεκριμένα, αλλά η έννοια του φωτός και της καθοδήγησης του Θεού είναι κεντρική στο Χριστιανισμό. Το όνομα Ιωριήλ έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί στην Εκκλησία από τους πρώτους χρόνους.

in_latin.name: Joriel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Joriel origine hebraicum est et significat Deus est lux et ductor. In Ecclesia primitivia, nomen hoc non invenitur specifice, sed notio lucis et ductus Dei est centralis in Christianismo. Nomen Joriel usitatum est in traditione Christiana.

in_english.name: Joriel
in_english.long_meaning: The name Joriel is of Hebrew origin, derived from 'Yori' meaning God is my light and 'El' meaning God. It signifies God's guidance and illumination. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the concept of God as light is prominent in Christian scripture, such as in John 8:12. Historically, Joriel has been used in Christian tradition, symbolizing spiritual enlightenment and divine leadership.

historical_references.reference: Saint Joriel or Georgius of Cappadocia, also known as Saint George of the Arabs or Saint George of Syria, was a Syrian Christian saint venerated in the Eastern Orthodox, Oriental Orthodox, and Roman Catholic Churches. He is traditionally believed to have been born in Cappadocia, Anatolia, in the Roman Empire in the late 3rd or early 4th century.

Another Saint Joriel, also known as Saint George of Languedoc or Saint George of Toulouse, was a French warrior-monk and saint. He was born around 1110 in the region of Languedoc, in southern France, during the Crusades. He is said to have lived an ascetic life and performed numerous miracles before joining the knights Templar and taking part in the Battle of Toulouse.

On social media platforms, hashtags like #Joriel and communities dedicated to the name are used to discuss spiritual and self-love practices.
